voice.pacing_note: v7 (owner, 2026-11-07, joint pacing recommendation rules P8, P10 and P20): every narration block ends with a hold of the picture of block_end_pause_s (a scene wait in RAScene, never audio: Azure drops a break after the last word, measured 2026-11-07); a block that ends with its own [pause S] holds S instead ([pause 0]: none). Inside a block [pause S] is an SSML break of at most voice.azure.max_break_ms. A block marked [slow] (a derivation or an argument) is read as a whole at voice.azure.slow_rate_pct; ordinary narration stays at rate_pct. The owner chose this on 2026-11-07 in a blind listening test of three Steffan HD takes of the descent passage, with the same breaks and holds: the whole block at -15 % (chosen), the key sentences alone at -15 %, and at -20 %. The sentence-level [key] of the joint recommendation is retired. Measured the same day on three derivation passages, three takes each: a slow block lasts 5-8 % longer (the rate model, 92/85, says 8 %), reads 152-174 words per minute with the planned pauses left out (ordinary: 162-183), its sentence-end pauses are as long as ordinary ones (0.88 against 0.83 s on the stem), and no pause inside a sentence reaches 0.7 s. The pace cap first adds breaks of up to pace_break_max_s at the sentence ends, then slows the block down to pace_min_rate_pct, then flags it for a rewrite; no block or sentence is ever read below min_rate_pct (-20: below it Steffan HD drags words, measured on v6), whatever this file says (templates/manim/voice.py RATE_FLOOR_PCT). block_end_pause_s is 0.75 s since round 2 with the learning-science reviewer (2026-11-07): measured on the narration stem, as rule P8 measures, v6's ordinary sentence ends inside blocks are silent for a median 1.01 s and its block ends for 0.30 s (the stem counts the voice's sentence-final decay as silence), so a 0.75 s hold brings block boundaries to about 1.05 s, never shorter than an ordinary sentence boundary; the joint file's 0.6 s would leave them at about 0.90 s.

azure.max_break_note: Measured 2026-11-07 on en-US-Steffan:DragonHDLatestNeural, TTS only (28 single-break takes of 1-12 s): no 5 s cap (12 s came back at 12.1-12.3 s), but long breaks are unreliable: up to 4 s, 2 of 18 takes stretched the pause by 3.5-5.6 s; 5-8 s, 5 of 10 takes by 3.4-15 s (voice_anomaly() retakes them). A break comes out 0.0-0.3 s longer than asked; two adjacent breaks add up; a break after the last word is dropped. A pause longer than 4 s ends the block and holds the picture (RAScene), never audio.
azure.note: Owner decision 2026-11-06: Azure en-US-Steffan:DragonHDLatestNeural is the narrator of the Remaining Action series (chosen over en-US-SamuelMultilingualNeural and others in a matched-pace comparison: about 150 words per minute, a 400 ms break between blocks, prosody rate -8 %). rate_pct -8 gives Steffan HD about 147-156 words per minute (measured 2026-11-06); a block faster than max_wpm (160, the top of the spoken-script standard's 140-160) is paced in the order of rule P20 (voice.pacing_note: breaks first, then a slower rate down to pace_min_rate_pct, then a rewrite; v6 slowed blocks to -30 %, which dragged words, so min_rate_pct is -20 since 2026-11-07). HD voices honour <prosody rate> and <break> and ignore mstts:silence (never used). Pauses come only from the service (punctuation, prosody rate, an ellipsis as a <break> of ellipsis_pause_s, a [pause S] as a <break> of S) and from holds of the picture between blocks; the audio is never cut, padded or spliced. HD takes are not deterministic: a take with an unplanned gap, an over-long word or a pace under min_wpm is synthesized again (up to retries times). Keys AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY and AZURE_SERVICE_REGION come from the environment only. Piper stays installed as the keyless voice (render_video.sh --voice piper); drafts are silent.

voice.disclosure: Script, figures and animations were produced with an AI-assisted pipeline, checked by scripts and independent reviewers, and approved by a human before publication.
voice.policy: Voice policy (README.md): one canonical narrator per series; changes only at series boundaries, announced; AI voices never presented as real or as different people; a second voice only as a named, disclosed character; the back catalogue is re-voiced on a change; rendered narration WAVs are archived; the reference paragraph is rendered at each change.

video.loudness_note: Integrated loudness of the final mix (EBU R128), set by a fixed gain after a measurement pass; YouTube normalises to about -14 LUFS and turns quieter videos up never. The true-peak ceiling is music.true_peak_dbtp, measured after AAC encoding. Owner decision 2026-11-04 (was -16).

music.note: Owner decision 2026-11-04, route A: original music only. tools/video/music.py synthesises it (seeded by the run slug unless seed is set; preset calm-pad), tools/video/assemble.py mixes it: the bed sits bed_in_gaps_lu below the narration's loudness in pauses and bed_under_voice_lu below it while the narration speaks (a sidechain duck with look-ahead), the motif sting on the title beat after the hook ('hook_title') and on the outro ('outro') at sting_lu. Per scene (plan.json scenes "music": bed | low | off, default modes_by_role) after the coherence principle (Moreno and Mayer 2000: background music under narrated explanation lowers recall and transfer): the bed in the hook, title beat and outro, 'low' (low_under_voice_lu, at least 20 LU under the voice) or 'off' under explanation; a swell of transition_swell_s at every cut. tools/gate.py requires the provenance stamp video/final/music.json for any music in the mix. Licensed or commissioned tracks (route B) are not supported yet: source must stay 'generated'; enabled false gives a voice-only mix. Stings (2026-11-04, after the v2 final-cut review FC-1): placed in a pause of the narration so that they end sting_margin_s before the next word (music.py sting_slot()), and ducked under the voice by sting_duck_db as a safety net; the final gate requires every music element to stay at least music_under_voice_max_lu under the narration while it speaks (EBU R128 momentary loudness of the mixed music against the narration's integrated loudness, over whole spoken words). bed_under_voice_lu -16 -> -18 (2026-11-04): with -16 the bed's own swells and bells reached -11.5 LU over words in episode 1 v2.
